note: The case table and every path string for
.github/scripts/classify_docs_only.py, kept as DATA rather than as
Python because the classifier's pin probe walks every tests/**/*.py and
collects its string literals. A table written inline would name
docs/getting-started/installation.md and its archive destination, the
probe would collect both, and the over-correction control below -- an
unpinned archival move that must stay inert -- would read as pinned by
the very test asserting it is not. That is not hypothetical: it is what
the first draft of this test did, and three cases failed until the
strings moved here. The probe parses no .json.
Cases with no 'literals' key run against the REAL tests/ tree, which is
where the issue measured them; a 'literals' key makes the case hermetic.

cases.why: the case the whole gate exists for -- prose and a command, nothing reads either
BOTH sides of an unpinned archival move. A fix that simply declared every rename non-inert passes every negative here and fails this one, so without it the set means nothing.
the destination is inert by location; the source is what makes the diff executable
a rename OUT of tests/ -- the suite shrinks, which is exactly when it must run
the rename hole itself: this is the one path `git diff --name-only` printed before --no-renames. Paired with the row above it is the whole argument for listing both sides.
the shipped KB pack; the Dockerfile COPYs resources/, so this diff changes the image

The same path with NOTHING pinning it, which is the only way to reach classify()'s resources/ arm -- the rooted allowlist the whole design rests on. On the real tree that path is pinned anyway (`resources/knowledge/pack/runbooks` is a literal in four test files), and the chain join took the remaining 88 unpinned resources/ paths to 0, so making resources/ inert kills no real-tree case. Hermetic literals are what keep the arm testable.
a root-level *.md is inert by location, but several tests pin this one
under docs/, but generated from the code and diffed by the api-contract-drift job
a change to CI is never docs-only -- including a change to this classifier
inertness is decided by LOCATION, not extension: nothing collects, imports or packages this
a test that joins a bare filename onto a root still pins the document
a literal containing a slash pins everything beneath it

DECIDED (#1539): a bare directory literal pins nothing beneath itself. `docs` is a literal on this tree today, so letting it pin would answer false for every docs-only diff and kill the gate silently. The directory-built-by-division case it was raised for is recovered in the WALK instead -- see test_a_directory_built_by_division_pins_beneath_itself.
the endswith arm is why the table above lives in JSON: one bare filename arms every path that ends in it

unreadable_note: Planted modules for the refusal (#1549): a `tests/` module that builds a
documentation path the pin probe cannot read must force the suites, and
one that builds an unreadable path naming NO document must not. Sources
live here for the same reason the case table does -- the probe walks
every tests/**/*.py and collects its string literals, so a planted
`docs/...` path written inline in the test module would arm that
document for the whole repository. The probe parses no .json.
Each case is run through `probe()` over a synthetic tests/ tree holding
the source plus the positive-control stand-in, so `fires` is measured
the way CI measures it rather than by calling the detector's internals.
